messages.subject: basic question on reactives / outputs
parts:
I know this is a basic question, but I can't quite see how to make this work: I want to show the same reactive text in two different tabs. 
The code below works but if I uncomment the part that says  
# , textOutput('mytextout')
then it doesn't work. It looks like you can't use the same output twice. So I guess I need a reactive that is not a simple output$ but how do I do that? 
Thanks

library(shiny)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$mytextout <- renderText({
    input$mytextin
  })
}

ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("How do I display some reactive text in two places?"),
  tabsetPanel(
    "tab 1",
    tabPanel(
      textInput('mytextin', "Enter text:", "defaul text"),
      h2(textOutput("mytextout", container = span))
    ),
    tabPanel(
      "tab2",
      h2('cannot say textOutput again with same output as before')  # , textOutput('mytextout')
    )
  ))

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
